For our Empower station at Dealer Conference, we're showcasing the campaign kits we've created for dealers. We'd like to use QR codes to lead dealers to each kit, and we'd like them to be trackable so we can see scans and visits from the event._x000D_
Could you help prepare QR codes for the following?_x000D_
- Migration SE Collection campaign kit_x000D_
- Karman campaign kit_x000D_
- High Performance Seating campaign kit_x000D_
- Work Better Resources_x000D_
What we need:_x000D_
- A separate tracked link for each kit (e.g. dealer conference, medium: QR), so we can tell the kits apart and separate event traffic from our usual traffic_x000D_
- High-res files (PNG/ JPEG) that work in print and on a digital screen_x000D_
Thanks!
